explanation: OEIS A038552 (largest squarefree k with Q(√−k) of class number n), R. Stephan: 'Numbers so far are all 19 mod 24.' The formal statement promotes this observation to a conjecture: every term, characterised by IsA038552 (maximal squarefree k with class number n), is ≡ 19 (mod 24). Faithful to the observation as a conjecture.
